components.role_description: number of rows n and number of groups k
array of k integers representing sizes of soldier groups

constraints.name: different_group_adjacent_exclusion
constraints.description: 飞机每排座位中,{1,2}、{3,4}、{4,5}、{5,6}、{7,8} 被定义为相邻座位。来自不同组的士兵不得坐在相邻座位上。
constraints.formal: 对于所有座位对 (u,v),若 u 与 v 相邻,则座位 u 和 v 上的士兵必须属于同一组。

constraints.name: fixed_group_cardinalities
constraints.description: 每个士兵组 i 必须恰好占据 a_i 个座位,即所有士兵必须被安置在飞机上。
constraints.formal: 设分配给组 i 的座位数为 x_i,则要求 x_i = a_i 对所有 i 成立。

objective.description: Determine if a valid seating arrangement exists

invariants.name: modular_fill_invariant
invariants.description: The feasibility of seating is preserved when each group's demand is greedily reduced by multiples of four using available four-seat blocks, because any valid arrangement can be transformed to consume whole four-seat blocks first without creating conflicts.

invariants.name: feasibility_preserving_reduction
invariants.description: After isolating multiples of four, the remaining demands and unused four-seat blocks can be combined according to a fixed set of patterns (pair 1+2, pair two 3s, etc.) that exhaust all possible non-conflicting placements within a four-seat block. Applying these reductions in any order preserves the existence of a valid arrangement, ultimately reducing the problem to a simple bound on the total demand for two-seat blocks.
